messages:
Marco: Quick heads-up — spotted multiple copy/paste inconsistencies in the quickstart examples that will trip up new devs. Filing here before I open a PR.

Renee: thanks — what did you find?

Marco: Three small things across languages:
1) env var names not standardized (REDWOODKEY vs REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_TOKEN)
2) some examples show raw Authorization header with REDWOOD_API_TOKEN while SDK snippets use REDWOOD_KEY
3) quickstart claims 'retries enabled' at top but only Go/Java have auto-retry; Node/Python are opt-in

akshat: Ugh, that explains a recent support thread where a student kept getting 401s after copy/paste. Can you paste one offending snippet?

Marco: Sure, here's the bad Dockerfile line I found: 
```
ENV REDWOODKEY=\"changeme\"
```
And a curl example using the old token name: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```
While the Python quickstart uses: 
```
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
```
So copy/paste across sections yields mismatch and 401.

Renee: OK we standardized on REDWOOD_KEY last year. Can you open a docs PR to normalize and add a short troubleshooting card listing common typos?

Marco: Will do. Also propose adding a 1-line \"SDK behavior\" callout near the top: \"Note: automatic retries vary by SDK; see SDK docs for Node/Python middleware examples.\"

akshat: Please also add a tiny code sample showing how to opt-in retries in Node and Python so folks can copy/paste right away. That should cut support tickets.

docs-bot: Created issue docs#956 \"quickstart snippet parity and retry notice\" and labeled docs/triage. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/956

Renee: When you open the PR, can you update CONTRIBUTING.md to call out canonical env var name and add a checklist item for snippet parity? We keep regenerating templates and some old snippets slip through.

Marco: PR 517 opened: replaces REDWOODKEY/REDWOOD_API_TOKEN with REDWOOD_KEY across quickstarts, fixes Dockerfile, adds a Troubleshooting > Auth card, and inserts the SDK behavior callout with links to Node/Python retry examples. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/517

Tara: reviewed and left a nit on wording for the retry callout. Also requested a one-line migration note for anyone using old env var names in infra.

akshat: lgtm. After merge we should backport to the onboarding repo template and run the scaffolder. I can handle that if CI artifacts are available.

Marco: Merged PR 517. Follow-up task created to update onboarding generator templates: ONB-222. Verified newly scaffolded sample repo works with REDWOOD_KEY and added the opt-in retry snippets.

Renee: awesome, thanks Marco + akshat. Small wins like this reduce a ton of first-touch friction. Closing thread. :sparkles:
